description: Use this when the connected learner asks what to study today or this week, what is overdue, or what is on their CertArc calendar. Returns the calendar as CertArc shows it: every entry with its date and status (Completed, In progress, Overdue, Due today, Scheduled, Locked), the next session by the calendar's own rule, this week, overdue entries, counts, the plan start, exam date and days to the exam. Dates are in the learner's plan time zone. Does not change the plan.

program.description: Certification to read. Omit for the one the learner studied most recently; every result names its certification and lists the learner's others.

name: get_study_plan
title: Study calendar
